ar: اَللَّهُمَّ بِسِرِّ هِ لَدَيْكَ ،وَبِسَيْرِهِ إِلَيْكَ ، أَمِّنْ خَوْفِيْ ،وَأَقِلْ عَثْرَتِيْ ، وَأَذْهِبْ حُزْنِيْ ، وَحِرْصِيْ ، وَكُنْ لِيْ ، وَخُذْنِيْ إِلَيْكَ مِنِّيْ ، وَارْزُقْنِيَ الْفَنَاءَ عَنِّيْ ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ مَفْتُوْنًا بِنَفْسِيْ ، مَحْجُوْبًا بِحِسِّيْ ، وَاكْشِفْ لِيْ عَنْ كُلِّ سِرٍّ مَكْتُوْمٍ . يَا حَيُّ . يَا قَيُّوْمُ .
tr: Allāhumma bi sirri hī ladayka, Wa bi sayri hī ilayka ammin khawfī, Wa aqil `athratī, Wa adh’hib ḥuznī, Wa ḥirṣī, Wa kun lī wa khudh nī ilayka min nī,Wa ‘rzuqniya ‘l-fanā’a `an nī, Wa lā taj`alnī maftūnan bi nafsī, Maḥjūban bi ḥissī, Wa ‘kshif lī `an kulli sirrin maktūmin, Yā Ḥayyu, Yā Qayyūm.
en: O Allah, by his secret with You and traversing to You, allay my fears, reduce my slips, remove my sadness and concerns, Be for me, take me from me to You and provide me with annihilation from my self! Do not make me tried by my ego and veiled by my senses and unveil to me every hidden secret, O Ever Living O Self-Sustaining!
